tunnelDown: Cannot reach {agent}'s computer — probably asleep, or not started yet.
appOk: It answers and the page has loaded.
appReady: It answers and the page reported ready.
appSilent: {agent}'s computer is connected, but the app does not answer; it may have exited.
appRestarted: The app just restarted; following the new instance.
appReconnecting: The connection dropped and is reconnecting; the loaded page stays on screen.
pageError: The page itself reported an error: {error}
unknown: The link before this one is down, so this one cannot be checked yet.
